questions.solution: 1. Salma Dam (2016) is a hydroelectric + irrigation project built with India’s support.

questions.questionText:
The largest known Harappan inscription, consisting of a signboard with 10 symbols displayed
prominently for public viewing, was discovered at which Indus Valley Civilisation site, and
what does its public placement most likely indicate about its purpose?
options:
Mohenjo-daro — It was a royal proclamation issued by a powerful king to announce
political decisions and military victories.

Harappa — It was a sacred religious text displayed near a temple complex for ritual and
ceremonial purposes.

Dholavira — It likely functioned as a civic, administrative, or commercial announcement
intended to be seen and understood by the public.

Lothal — It served as a port authority notice displaying customs duties and trade
regulations for foreign merchants.
questions.solution: Dholavira, one of the most remarkable urban centres of the Indus Valley Civilisation, is famous for yielding the largest known Harappan inscription discovered so far. The inscription consists of 10 large symbols or signs made from gypsum and mounted on a wooden board.

questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements regarding Operation Lion’s Roar and Ayatollah Ali
Khamenei:
I. Operation Lion’s Roar targeted senior Iranian political and military leaders including
members of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.
II. Ayatollah Ali Khamenei served as the Supreme Leader of Iran from 1979 until 2026.
III. Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in an Israeli airstrike in Tehran during the early phase
of Operation Lion’s Roar.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution: Statements I and III are correct. Operation Lion’s Roar involved military strikes targeting high-ranking Iranian political and military leaders, including members of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements regarding the legal justification advanced by the United
States for Operation Absolute Resolve:
1. The US relied upon Article 51 of the UN Charter to justify its actions.
2. Article 2(4) of the UN Charter generally prohibits the use of force against another state's
territorial integrity.
8. The UN Charter expressly permits regime-change operations against governments whose
legitimacy is disputed.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution: Article 51 concerns self-defence, while Article 2(4) prohibits the use of force against another state. The UN Charter does not expressly permit regime-change operations merely because a government's legitimacy is disputed.

questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the use of Thorium-232 in the reactor:
I. Thorium-232 is designed to serve as the main fuel for the first stage of India’s nuclear
power programme.
Il. The reactor is designed to eventually use Thorium-232 in the blanket.
Ill. Through transmutation, Thorium-232 will be converted into Uranium-233 for the third
stage of India’s nuclear power programme.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution: Statements II and III are correct because the reactor is designed to eventually use Thorium-232 in the blanket, and this material can be converted through transmutation into Uranium-233. Uranium-233 is significant because it will support the third stage of India’s nuclear power programme.

questions.questionText:

Aayog:
I. The Fiscal Health Index covers all states and Union Territories of India for its fiscal

fiscal health of states in India.
III. While the first edition assessed eighteen major states, the latest edition also includes ten
North-Eastern and Himalayan states.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution: Statements II and III are correct. The initiative aims to enhance understanding of the fiscal health of states in India, and the updated edition expands its scope beyond the initial eighteen major states to include ten North-Eastern and Himalayan states.

questions.questionText:

Bagh:

administration.

questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements regarding recommendations on the appointment and
removal of Governors in India:
I. The Sarkaria Commission recommended appointing an eminent person from outside the
concerned state and avoiding individuals active in politics in the recent past.
II. The Punchhi Commission recommended removing the doctrine that the Governor
continues in office during the pleasure of the President of India.
III. The National Commission to Review the Working of the Constitution recommended that
Governors should normally complete the full five-year tenure mentioned in the
Constitution.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution: All three statements correctly represent recommendations made by major commissions examining Centre—State relations and the functioning of the Governor’s office in India. The Sarkaria Commission advised appointing eminent individuals from outside the state and avoiding recently active politicians to ensure neutrality.

questions.questionText:

questions.questionText:

questions.solution: + The Indian Space Research Organisation's Gaganyaan mission will place the crew in a Low Earth Orbit (LEO) of about 400 km. Hence, saying approximately 300-400 km is acceptable.

questions.questionText:
